exams.name: Adjuster Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Exam requirement and residency requirement are waived if the applicant holds a current claims certificate issued by a national or state-based claims association with a certification program approved by the director consisting of at least 40 hours of preexamination course work, a proctored examination, and at least 24 hours of CE required for certification renewals on a biennial basis.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by or under supervision of the director)
exams.quote: Take and pass an examination that is given by or under the supervision of the director and that reasonably tests the applicant's knowledge of insurance and legal responsibilities as an adjuster

available.quote: Be a resident of this state or a resident of another state that allows residents of this state to act as adjusters in the other state.

requirements.value: An adjuster licensed or allowed to act as an adjuster in their domicile state is exempt from AZ licensing if sent to AZ on behalf of an insurer to investigate or adjust a particular loss or series of losses from a common catastrophe. Residency and exam requirements are waived for applicants holding a qualifying national or state-based claims association certificate.
requirements.quote: An adjuster who is licensed or allowed to act as an adjuster in the state of the adjuster's domicile is not required to be licensed pursuant to this section or meet the qualifications prescribed in this section if the adjuster is sent to this state on behalf of an insurer for the purpose of investigating or making adjustment of a particular loss under an insurance policy or a series of losses resulting from a catastrophe common to all those losses.
